measurements.comparisonScope: Same-process e4d6b84 body-algorithm replay and current cached body path over identical SwiftData model objects. The legacy path rebuilds fully derived item/group/tag values, retains its projection cache exactly as the old @State did, then rebuilds DashboardFilterCatalog and runs full ServerBrowserQuery filtering/sorting on every body evaluation. The current path rebuilds exact raw metadata inputs, derives UUID/name/group/tag values only after relevant input changes, reuses catalog/filter results, and maps cached indices back to servers.
measurements.diagnostics: Cold catalog/filter uses prebuilt inputs. Five-query timing exercises current cached projection queries and is not part of the legacy/current body ratio.
measurements.excluded: Geometry, SwiftUI layout, card body rendering, scrolling, and first-frame presentation are excluded. This is a dashboard metadata/filter body-path microbenchmark.
measurements.releaseInvocation: Scripts/benchmark-macos.sh compiles and runs this comparison in Release with -O.
